title: Low degree one Fourier weight implies dictator approximation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. Suppose $0\leq\delta\leq 1/1600$ and the sum of the squares of the level-one Fourier coefficients of $f$ is at least $1-\delta$. Then there is a coordinate $i$ and a choice of sign such that the fraction of inputs on which $f$ differs from that signed coordinate function is at most $1601\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: The level-one Fourier weight of $f$ is at least $1-\delta$
